wins: Mapped target network perimeter with masscan/nmap and documented open services (run_20260217_033033_832d79: ep001_step04, ep001_step08).
Captured SSH and HTTP banners for later enumeration, enabling focused credential attack paths (ep001_step06, ep001_step10).
fails: Initial foothold was not achieved: brute force against SSH/HTTP services exhausted but blocked by rate limits (ep001_step12, ep001_step13).
Privilege escalation attempt using local exploits failed because the kernel was fully patched (ep001_step14).
key_outcomes.summary: reconnaissance was well-executed, but the kill chain stalled at lateral movement due to hardened services and protected privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Credential brute-force attempts against SSH and HTTP services hit rate limiting and lockouts before a valid login could be found.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run ssh-auth-methods and key enumeration using nmap with ssh2-enum-algos and ssh-hostkey scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service exposes versioned banner on port 80 or 8080
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto followed by wfuzz for identified CGI scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows SMB port 445 is reachable
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient enumeration followed by crackmapexec users module

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in gathering actionable SSH metadata for potential brute-force and key reuse.
Identified multiple HTTP endpoints suitable for content discovery and exploitation.
